title: Chronological Correlation Composer: Threaded Request Timeline & Filtered Span Cards
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Design and prototype a consolidated tracing workspace that composes chronological request threads (by correlation id) into a row-based timeline with compact span cards, powerful facet filters, and lightweight cross-request stitching. Goals: make it faster for engineers to answer: 'Which downstream spans contributed to this latency spike?', 'Which rollout or model variant handled these requests?', and 'What was the cost delta for this trace sample?'. The composer should be embeddable in Route and Rollout detail pages and expose links to the Cost Breakdown and Rollout events.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Timeline canvas shows a collapsible row per correlated request sequence; 2) Span cards show key metadata (duration, op, model_variant, correlation_id, error badge) and expand to show tags/kv; 3) Facet filters allow AND/OR queries across duration buckets, model_variant, rollout_tag, region, and error types; 4) Time-scrub + minimap to jump to hotspots; 5) Ability to pin spans to 'investigation shelf' and export selected spans to an incident note; 6) Lightweight cost overlay shows estimated token cost per span and per request sequence.
